claim: The one-click demo uses sample data and never changes the real household board.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create real data, change the demo, leave demo, and assert real data is unchanged

claim: Completed chores rotate to the next eligible person and skip dated absences.
sandbox: fresh /demo board; add an absence spanning the next due date, complete the chore, and assert the absent person is skipped

claim: Exports preserve the full board as JSON and the activity log as CSV.
sandbox: fresh /demo board; download and parse both files, asserting sample household, chore count, CSV header, and activity rows

claim: A shared link contains a read-only current-board snapshot without history.
sandbox: fresh /demo board; open its generated fragment URL in a new page and assert assignments appear without actions or history

claim: Household data stays in the browser unless the user exports or shares it.
where: landing facts, footer, settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo board; observe all requests while completing and resetting, and assert every request is same-origin

claim: The installed app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; wait for service-worker control, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample board and offline state

claim: The free board supports four people and six chores; Plus costs $12 once and removes those limits.
where: landing facts, Plus panel, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo board; reach four people and six chores, assert both next additions are gated, and verify the displayed one-time offer

claim: Fair Turn installs as a standalone PWA.
sandbox: fresh /demo visit; validate the standalone manifest, maskable icon, and ready service-worker registration

claim: The board supports keyboard use, reduced motion, dark theme, and a 390 px screen.
sandbox: fresh /demo at 390 px with reduced motion and dark preference; assert no overflow, keyboard focus, theme switching, and zero serious/critical Axe findings
